name: IEXCBP
rootCause: DefiLlama catalogued an incident affecting IEXCBP on BNB Chain on 2026-05-12 with reported losses of about $97,000. The public evidence currently available for this entry is limited to a catalogue classification describing the event as spot price manipulation, and no primary exploit transactions, protocol disclosures, or vulnerable contract code were independently verified. The only currently available public classification describes the incident as oracle manipulation through spot price manipulation. No independently verified exploit transaction, protocol disclosure, or vulnerable contract implementation was available to confirm the exact mechanism.
